llm_response.reason: The site presents claims of extremely high and guaranteed returns (up to 80%), immediate withdrawals, copy trading and expert support without transparency. Testimonials are unverifiable and use large numbers to bait investors. There is no reference to a legitimate business: no company registration, office address, or governance, and all contact info is generic. The domain is newly registered to an individual in Nigeria, not an actual financial entity. Crypto payments are emphasized, and privacy/terms are vague, all hallmarks of an investment scam. Multiple scam website characteristics (2, 3, 4, 7, 8, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16) are present.
